steps.name: Reject duplicate JSON object keys
steps.rule: Duplicate object keys MUST be rejected before ordinary JSON parsing.

steps.name: Reject duplicate parent hashes
steps.rule: Serialized parentHashes MUST NOT contain duplicates.

steps.name: Reject unsorted parent hashes
steps.rule: Serialized parentHashes MUST already equal normalized canonical order.

steps.name: Reject self-parent
steps.rule: A Block MUST NOT contain its own blockHash in parentHashes.

steps.name: Enforce parent-count maximum
steps.rule: Normalized parentHashes MUST contain no more than 256 items.

steps.name: Detect cycles
steps.rule: The reachable parent graph MUST be acyclic.

steps.name: Apply closed-world validation by default
steps.rule: All parent hashes MUST resolve unless explicit open-world validation context is supplied.

steps.name: Reject undeclared external parents
steps.rule: A missing parent is valid only when open-world validation is active and the parent is explicitly declared external.

steps.name: Validate Trace edge endpoints
steps.rule: Every resolved edge endpoint MUST appear in trace.nodes unless the parent endpoint is declared external.

steps.name: Validate Trace leaves
steps.rule: Trace leaves MUST equal recomputed resolved leaves.

steps.name: Validate Trace max depth
steps.rule: Trace maxDepth MUST equal recomputed maxDepth.

steps.name: Validate Trace cycle status
steps.rule: Trace cycle MUST match verifier cycle detection.

steps.name: Validate Trace missing parents
steps.rule: Trace missingParents MUST equal unresolved undeclared parents.

steps.name: Validate Trace external parents
steps.rule: Trace externalParents MUST equal unresolved declared external parents.

steps.name: Validate Trace completeness
steps.rule: Trace complete MUST match verifier completeness computation.

steps.name: Validate Trace node metrics
steps.rule: Trace node metrics MUST match verifier recomputation.
